answer: Wharf bridge-toll commit-reveal bond: a wharf post per agent, 70 credits locked, entry and count hashed pre-epoch. Zephyr beacon posts the gust reading; entry, count, and gust are revealed, hash rechecked on bridge log and zephyr table. Mismatch, reuse, or missed reveal burns the bond; rented-reveal rings fail on copies. Each fake pays 38, locks 70; 1,000 fakes pay 38,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay once and keep the bond.
